sections.title: Quad Cities Superintendent Notice No. 10
sections.text:
Quad Cities Superintendent Notice No. 10 
Page | 1  
 
                                                  
 
 
January 1, 2025 
 
SUBDIVISIONS: Chicago, Davenport, Eldridge, Kansas City, Marquette, Nitrin, Ottumwa, 
Rockford, Laredo 
NOTICES IN EFFECT: 1-10 
NOTICES CANCELLED:     
SUBJECT: CMA FRA Tie-Up 
 
 
Effective immediately, Train and Engine employees are reminded as to ensure accuracy of information when entering into CMA for 
FRA records on FRA Audit Screen in MAC4.  
 
 
1. FRA records should be completed at the end of your tour of duty 
 
2. Employees not able to certify their FRA due to exceeding HOS need to complete FRA certification next time on duty 
 
3. In the event you have an error or are unable to certify event due to an error please contact CMC to resolve issue 
 
4. on Need to ensure when tying up that relieved and released locations are accurate for proper tracking of 
qualifications 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
LOGAN IVES – ASST SUPERINTENDENT – QUAD CITIES 
Please contact your Employee Assistance Program at 1-800-624-5544 [or visit www.eap.ndbh.com; Login: CP] for any social or 
personal problems that you or your family need assistance with.
